fusions.name: Tow Hook Cast
fusions.desc: Throws a tow hook that deals 7 damage to the first enemy in its path, then links on to 2 more enemies within 3.5 tiles for 60% of that damage each. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Dragged Behind
fusions.desc: Hooks the target and drags it behind you. It deals 18 damage, uses up every affliction you have on the target for 50% more damage each, then leaves it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds and 40% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Winch In
fusions.desc: Anchors a winch point ahead of you for 4 seconds that drags every enemy near it inward. Anything it catches moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Convoy Coupling
fusions.desc: Conjures a coupling that links you to your convoy: your critical hit chance rises by 5%, your critical hits deal 15% more damage, each kill returns 3 health, and you move 4% faster. The effect grows 5% for each ally within 5.5 tiles, up to 4 allies.
